name: DIG Local SEO & AI Post Booster
author: digitalinnovationglobal

sections.description:
DIG Local SEO & AI Post Booster is a comprehensive WordPress plugin designed to maximize organic traffic, user retention, and local search visibility for blogs and local businesses (hotels, hospitality, tourism, dining, retail, professional services, and regional directories).

The plugin combines technical on-page SEO enhancements with automated structured data and next-generation AI content creation powered by the Google Gemini API.

🌟 Key Features

  1. Automatic Table of Contents (TOC):

    • Automatic hierarchical detection of <h2> and <h3> headings.
    • Clean, SEO-friendly anchor links without special character corruption.
    • Smooth scroll and scrollspy tracking to highlight active reading sections.
    • Collapsible interface with shortcode [geo_seo_toc].

  2. Estimated Reading Time Badge:

    • Dynamic calculation based on customizable words-per-minute (WPM).
    • Visual badge with clock icon, estimated minutes, and total word count.
    • Shortcode [geo_seo_reading_time] for custom placement.

  3. Spanish Readability Diagnostics:

    • Native Flesch-Szigriszt (F-SZ) and Fernández-Huerta (IFH) formulas calibrated for Spanish syllable structures.
    • Real-time analysis in the post editor: long sentence percentages, paragraph density, and discourse connectives ratio.

  4. Geo-SEO & Structured Data (JSON-LD):

    • Automatic geolocation meta tags (ICBM, geo.position, geo.placename, geo.region).
    • Schema BlogPosting with contentLocation and precise GPS coordinates.
    • Schema Event for trade shows, festivals, conferences, and exhibitions.
    • Schema FAQPage with expandable accordion questions in search results.

  5. AI Content Studio & Local Trend Radar (Google Gemini API):

    • Real-Time Local Radar: Discover upcoming trade fairs, expos, festivals, and cultural events in your target city using Google Search Grounding.
    • 1-Click Post Generation: Write comprehensive, SEO-optimized articles with structured headings, FAQs, local business entity integration, and conversion call-to-actions (CTA).
    • Direct creation of WordPress drafts with auto-populated metadata.

💎 Upgrade to Booster PRO: Autonomous Growth & Multi-Language

Ready to take your local search rankings to the next level? Discover the extra power of DIG Local SEO Booster PRO:

  • ⚡ Autonomous Radar Autopilot (Cron Background Automation): Set it and forget it. The AI radar scans local trends and automatically generates weekly or monthly scheduled drafts without lifting a finger.
  • 🌍 1-Click 6-Language Simultaneous Generation: Automatically produce high-ranking local content in Spanish, English, Catalan, French, German, and Italian simultaneously to capture international tourists, expatriates, and foreign customers.
  • 🛡️ Protected Brand Glossary: Lock corporate trademarks, product names, and legal terms so the AI never mistranslates or alters them.
  • 🎨 Automated AI Featured Image Studio: Create matching high-resolution editorial featured images via Google Imagen, ready to publish with proper alt tags.
  • 🏢 Agency & White Label Suite: Rebrand the plugin with your agency identity, hide vendor links, and export/import pre-configured client templates in seconds.
  • ⭐ VIP Priority Support & Updates: Direct engineering support with guaranteed SLA (<12h) and continuous automatic updates.

    External services

    This plugin integrates with external third-party APIs provided by Google to deliver AI generation and real-time local search capabilities:

  • Google Gemini API & Google Imagen API

    • Service Provider: Google LLC (https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com)
    • Purpose: Generates SEO-optimized post drafts, outlines, and structured FAQ sections; conducts real-time local trend and event discovery via Google Search Grounding; and generates featured image assets.
    • When data is sent: Data is only transmitted when an authorized administrator explicitly triggers an action in the WordPress administration dashboard (e.g., clicking “Rastrear Tendencias”, “Generar Post Completo”, “Generar Imagen”, or testing the API connection).
    • Data transmitted: The user’s Google Gemini API key and prompt parameters (target city, region, business category, topic/keyword, selected language, and tone of voice). No personal visitor data, user credentials, or private WordPress database records are ever transmitted.
    • Terms of Service: https://ai.google.dev/terms and https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Shortcodes

  • [geo_seo_toc] : Inserts the Table of Contents.
  • [geo_seo_reading_time] : Inserts the estimated reading time badge.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dig-local-seo-post-booster folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the .zip archive via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to DIG Local SEO > Settings & Profile to configure your business city, region, and Google Gemini API key.
  4. Go to DIG Local SEO > AI Generator & Trends to scan for local opportunities and draft targeted content.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Gemini API key?

Yes, to use the AI Generator and Local Trend Radar features. You can obtain a free API key from Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com). Core features like the Table of Contents, Reading Time, Readability analysis, and Geo Schemas work without an API key.

Is the Table of Contents automatically inserted?

Yes, you can configure automatic insertion before the first heading, or use the [geo_seo_toc] shortcode to place it anywhere inside your post.

Which readability formulas are used?

We use Flesch-Szigriszt (F-SZ) and Fernández-Huerta (IFH), which are specifically adapted and calibrated for the Spanish language, unlike standard English Flesch-Kincaid.

What is the difference between the Free and PRO versions?

The Free version provides all core on-page SEO features (automatic Table of Contents, Reading Time estimation, Spanish readability diagnostics, and Geo-SEO JSON-LD schemas) plus on-demand AI post generation with Google Gemini.

The PRO version introduces autonomous background publishing (Autopilot Cron), simultaneous 1-click 6-language generation (ES, EN, CA, FR, DE, IT), brand glossaries, automated AI featured images, white label agency tools, and direct VIP engineering support.

Can I use the PRO version on client websites?

Yes! The Agency and Lifetime licenses include multi-site activations and full White Label capability, allowing you to rebrand the plugin with your agency identity and hide vendor links.
sections.changelog:
1.1.5

  • Fix: Full multilingual translation compatibility for Reading Time prefix, word count labels, and Table of Contents (TOC) title and toggle texts with Gettext integration (Digital Translate WP, WPML, Polylang).
  • Improvement: Clean separation of reading time icon emoji in HTML markup to prevent duplicate icons and guarantee clean string translation.
  • Fix: Hooked load_plugin_textdomain on init and added localized toggle text strings to frontend JavaScript.

1.1.4

  • Feature: Added official Digital Innovation Global ecosystem cross-promotion tab and PRO upgrade showcase.
  • Improvement: Renamed plugin to DIG Local SEO & AI Post Booster and updated text domain to dig-local-seo-post-booster to avoid brand name conflicts.
  • Security: Implemented deep field-by-field sanitization for nested arrays (geo_meta, event_meta, suggested_tags, faqs) in AJAX handler.
  • Security: Added JSON_HEX escaping flags to wp_json_encode in JSON-LD structured data output to prevent script tag breakout.
  • Compliance: Added External Services documentation in readme.txt detailing Google Gemini API usage, privacy policy, and terms of service.

1.1.3

  • Fix: Enhanced FAQ extraction and fallback mechanism ensuring 100% of generated articles retain complete FAQ sections and Schemas.
  • Fix: Expanded search boundaries for retail openings and local commercial establishments.

1.1.2

  • Fix: Dynamic loading status messages tailored to each selected category in Local Trend Radar.
  • Fix: Robust JSON response handling and fallback trend extractor to prevent parsing errors under high Gemini search grounding volumes.

1.1.1

  • Fix: Enforced strict category filtering in the Local Trend Radar with negative prompt boundaries to eliminate category bleeding.
  • Fix: Prevented fatal collision error between Free and PRO versions with automatic graceful deactivation.
  • Fix: Passed language filter dynamically into trend discovery search grounding.

1.1.0

  • Feature: Added language selector in the Local Trend Radar with strict Gemini prompt lock.
  • Fix: Fixed content transfer to WordPress post draft from the AI Post Studio.
  • Fix: Fixed literal newline rendering (\n\n) in generated HTML content.
  • Fix: Stripped UTF-8 BOM to prevent unexpected output activation notices.
  • Fix: Sanitized all filter inputs and improved WordPress Plugin Check compliance.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Features Table of Contents, Reading Time badge, Spanish readability analysis, Geo-SEO JSON-LD schemas, and Google Gemini AI trend discovery.
